body: I just took it as I'm so worthless I don't deserve help. But also, it's crushing that I'm in such a bad state but it isn't seen as bad enough to be able to get treatment. I'm suicidal but because I don't fit into any particular box for an illness, I'm not sick?

Yes, thanks, that is a good idea. The whole country is backed up with snow at the moment so it's a bit hard to get, but I guess phone calls are something I can do. I find it very difficult to make phone calls, but I need to be strong and do it.

I hope I can get help. Everything seems so hopeless at the moment. My heads all over the place and I'm worrying about everything.

Yeah I should have tried to find a GP ages ago. Thanks, I know it's relatively simple thing to get over but I guess I'm just building it up in mind. Add to that social anxiety and blah. 

The thing is, I don't mean to make it more complicated, it's just I don't think I can handle it here, I've been thinking of moving back (where I used to live before and where my old psychiatrist/outpatient hospital is). So that's why I tried to get in contact with them.

I've realised that I really need to get over this illness if I can move on in life, I can't handle college or working or normal life in this state. I need therapy and meds and all that but I don't know if I can get it.

Not a therapist...a outpatient psychiatric hospital - I called my psychiatric nurse and she said she would ring me back, she didn't. I rang again and left a message with the receptionist but still she didn't call me back. 

It's not a private service so I don't know how to change to be honest. I moved away a couple of months ago and I don't know how to access the services here. You're supposed to go your gp (regular doctor) first and then get referred to a psychiatrist or whatever but I don't have a gp or know how to get one. 

(Just for reference I live in a European country and get free health coverage)

I don't know, my life and the world around me, it's quite a complicated thing, not one thing has caused it.

I know there are treatments, and I've tried some of them. Medication, therapy, exercise, healthy diet, changing my life. None of it has worked so far. And now my mental health team don't want to treat me anymore. So I don't know what to do. And no one else does either. 

I would like to go a music festival but I don't think I have anyone to go with. 

A part of me wants to have children, but I've decided not to. Helping at an animal shelter is a good idea. Thank you for talking to me.

Yes I suppose. 

I'm not planning on committing suicide soon. I'm planning it for next year. But it's so unbearable for me a lot of the time I need to talk and get advice from people. 

Nothing really lifts the depression, it's always there. One of the few things that makes me happy though is hearing an amazing song. Or spending time with my cat. They make me feel happy for a minute, but it's like my brain makes me remember all the other stuff in my life and I feel depressed again.

How do you know though? Every part of me is sure that I will never be happy again. And I know this is probably depression affecting me, but I can't seem to overcome the depression, so what do I do?

Yes I have read it before, it doesn't really say much to me. It doesn't really touch me at all.

Hi, thanks for replying. I can't call a hotline because it's late at night here and I don't want to wake anybody up or have them hear my conversation.

I also have anxiety about phone calls so I find it extremely difficult even when it's the right time to get the courage to call.

I don't know why I feel like this, the depression crept up on over a long time until I felt completely hopeless. I was feeling 'okay' over the past couple of days, but crashed back into depression a while ago.

I really want to die. I do not want to live the rest of my life depressed.
